reviews.x: I keep these by my sink - one with white vinegar and one with hydrogen peroxide, for disinfecting surfaces (especially wooden or bamboo cutting boards).  Turns out, if you use first one, then the other, they mix on the surface to make a pretty darned effective disinfectant, with really benign impacts on humans and the environment.  Because the bottle is dark amber, it gives the hydrogen peroxide some protection from light - especially since I use it up so quickly.

My only wish is that they had a black (or even brown) nozzle instead of white. These bottles were exactly what I needed, and I'm highly pleased with their leakproof tops and dependable sprayers. If I need more (and I probably will) I know where to come.

The lid stays on in my purse and it's easy to spray on and get just the right amount rather than squeezing out too much of the store bought. I want to make some for gifts but will buy smaller bottles...these hold a lot and it's a little big for a purse.

reviews.t: 4 Pack of Plastic Bottles - works great

I have four kids so I must have been distracted when researching this. Haha. Any way, all in all it is a 4 PACK of PLASTIC bottles. It does it's job just fine. :)

claims.text: Many reviewers find these bottles ideal for DIY essential oil and homemade sprays, praising the PET plastic as safe for oils.
The dark/amber color is valued for protecting light-sensitive contents and blocking damaging light.
Several reviewers report defective or poorly fitting spray nozzles and caps, with tops popping off or the whole nozzle pulling out.
Some reviewers note the pumps/sprayers start to stick or fail over time.
Reviewers appreciate the leakproof tops, dependable sprayers, and generous tubing length.
